judges_raw: (Before Dr Anita Sumanth and Sunder Mohan, JJ.)
appellants: Ambiga M/A-57 Years Wife of Sivadoss
respondents: State of Tamil Nadu, Rep. by its Secretary to Government, (Home), Prohibition and Excise Department, Secretariat and Others
advocates: For Respondents : Mr. R. Muniyapparaj Additional Public Prosecutor assisted by Mr. M. Sylvester John
judgment_text:
Prayer : Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying to issue a writ of habeas corpus to call for the records pertaining to call for the records pertaining to the order of detention passed in Cr.MP.No. 14/2025 dated 18.08.2025 passed by the 2nd respondent and set aside the same and directing the respondents to produce the petitioner's son, Rajesh, son of Sivadoss, aged about 34 years before this Court, now confined in Central Prison, Thiruchirappalli and set him at liberty.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Dr Anita Sumanth, J.:—

Mr. R. Muniyapparaj, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, states that nothing survives in this matter as the detention order in Cr.M.P. No. 14/2025 dated 18.08.2025 passed against the detenu has been revoked by the Government by its order in G.ORt.No. 6117 Home, Prohibition and Excise (XV) Department, dated 24.09.2025, recording which, this Habeas Corpus Petition is closed. No costs.
